answer_1.quote: We experiment both with deterministic segmentation and stochastic segmentation using BPE Dropout . At training time, BPE Dropout randomly discards BPE merges with probability p, a hyperparameter of the method. As a result of this, the text gets stochastically segmented into smaller units.
